requirements.text: Personalised timetable management allowing users to assign different colours to classes based on type (lectures, tutorials, important events) with the option to select their own colours.
Automated grade notifications delivered as push notifications on users’ phones, including the module name and the actual grade.

A structured module feedback system that allows students to provide feedback on content quality, lecture delivery, and resource usefulness, using a simple form with specific questions and a rating scale from 1 to 5.
The enhancements should be seamlessly integrated into the existing portal, ensuring that the current login and access processes remain unchanged.
The focus should be on making the new features user-friendly and easy to access.
